title: Social Media API
description: Build a social media API with users, posts, following, feed, and likes.

steps.title: Create a user
steps.description: Create POST /api/users that accepts JSON with "username" and "email", assigns an id, and returns 201.

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class UserIn(BaseModel):
    username: str
    email: str

class User(BaseModel):
    id: int
    username: str
    email: str
    followers: list[int] = []
    following: list[int] = []

users = []
next_user_id = 1

@app.post('/api/users', status_code=201)
def create_user(u: UserIn):
    global next_user_id
    user = User(id=next_user_id, username=u.username, email=u.email)
    next_user_id += 1
    users.append(user)
    return user

steps.description: Add GET /api/users/:id that returns a user by id. Return 404 if not found.
hints: Find user by id in the users array

steps.title: Create a post
steps.description: Create POST /api/posts that accepts JSON with "userId" and "content". Assign an id and return 201.
hints: Create a post object with id, userId, content, likes, and createdAt

steps.description: Add GET /api/feed that returns posts from users the current user follows. Accept a "userId" query parameter.
hints: Read req.query.userId to identify the current user
Get the list of user IDs they follow

from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
from datetime import datetime
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class UserIn(BaseModel):
    username: str
    email: str

class FollowIn(BaseModel):
    userId: int

class User(BaseModel):
    id: int
    username: str
    email: str
    followers: list[int] = []
    following: list[int] = []

class PostIn(BaseModel):
    userId: int
    content: str

class Post(BaseModel):
    id: int
    userId: int
    content: str
    likes: list[int] = []
    createdAt: datetime = datetime.now()

users = [User(id=1, username='alice', email='alice@test.com', following=[2]), User(id=2, username='bob', email='bob@test.com', followers=[1])]
next_user_id = 3
posts = [Post(id=1, userId=2, content='Hello from Bob!')]
next_post_id = 2

@app.get('/api/feed')
def get_feed(userId: int):
    user = next((u for u in users if u.id == userId), None)
    if not user:
        return {'error': 'User not found'}
    return [p for p in posts if p.userId in user.following]
